sql: select e.key as experiment, e.state, v.version, d.deployment_key, d.kind, d.started_at, d.ended_at, ar.arm_key, a.strategy_tag from experiment_deployments d join experiment_epochs ep on ep.id=d.epoch_id join experiment_versions v on v.id=ep.version_id join experiments e on e.id=v.experiment_id left join experiment_deployment_arms a on a.deployment_id=d.id left join experiment_arms ar on ar.id=a.arm_id where e.key in ('mmsell-price-ceiling-capacity','mmsell-price-ceiling-contest-cap','mmsell-correlation-cap') and (d.ended_at is null or d.ended_at > now() - interval '2 hours') order by e.key, d.started_at
